findings.claim: Outside an engagement latch, brain.ts shoots the nearest clear enemy, not the one it would kill fastest, even though Build 14 already computes per-enemy time-to-kill (race()).

sources.quote: // Target: the nearest enemy mech with a clear shot, else the nearest one we know is there.
return { ttk: out > 0 ? e.hp! / out : Infinity, ttd: taken > 0 ? me.hp / taken : Infinity }
% of mech hits on targets under 50% HP: winner 46.6 top4 37.1 bottom 24.7

findings.suggested_change: Next build (one mechanism, brain.ts target sort at :651): among clear targets, after the engaged-target tiebreak, sort by ttk from race() (enemy hp / ourDps at its distance) instead of distance; fall back to distance on ties or when hp is missing. Behind a flag (e.g. TARGET_TTK_ON) so it rolls back to Build 14 exactly. Expected: +0.1 to +0.3, more kills, because the squad converges late (more targets at once) and split damage across full-HP hunters kills nobody.
findings.mechanism: In practice every point is a squad death before ours. With two or more hunters in view, concentrating fire on the one closest to dying turns damage into kills (each worth about a point and its cubes + 2) before the squad's damage turns into our death. The finish rule only covers the engaged target; this applies the same idea to every shot.

failure_classes.basis: damage spread over full-HP enemies yields no kill
late-match squad convergence: several hunters in view at once (track rules)

findings.claim: While the laser leads, the torso aims straight at the target with no lead, so the gun's onTarget(gunAim) check fails against a sideways mover beyond about 65 m and the gun stays silent for the whole 0.75 s charge.

sources.ref: mechfight-kit/check/stream.jsonl.gz hello.config (gun speed 252, mech radius 2.5, walk_speed 11.7, laser charge 0.75, cooldown 1.65)

findings.suggested_change: When both laser and gun are held, fire the gun with the laser's direct aim when the lead offset (sideways speed x d / gun speed) is under the target radius, and otherwise aim at gunAim during the charge and release the laser only when |aim - direct| is within yawTol. Candidate for after the target-choice build.
findings.mechanism: The lead a sideways mover needs at walk speed is 11.7 x d / 252 = 0.046 x d m. That passes the 3 m tolerance (radius 2.5 x 1.2) at about 65 m. The charge is 0.75 of each 2.4 s laser cycle, so about 31% of the time the gun (about 102 DPS sustained) is silenced against moving targets at mid range. This may be part of why Build 8 (laser first) lost: a laser can replace gun DPS instead of adding to it.

failure_classes.basis: code reading plus arithmetic from config, no per-match data

findings.claim: A started laser charge keeps charging when the target loses line of sight or the laser stops leading, so it auto-fires after hold_s (2 s past full charge) along whatever the torso faces and then spends its 1.65 s cooldown.

sources.quote: a full charge held for `hold_s` 2 s more fires on its own

findings.suggested_change: When charging and the target is no longer clear or in range, release only if it is on target; otherwise keep the charge and re-aim at the nearest clear enemy before the hold_s auto-fire. Small fix, can ride with the laser-aim change.
findings.mechanism: A wasted full charge throws away 315 damage plus 2.4 s of laser cycle, and charging also halves our walk speed (charge_move_mult 0.5) while it lasts, during retreats too.

failure_classes.basis: code reading; frequency unknown without match data
